lessons.title: Ecclesiastical Pronunciation — Vowels
lessons.content: A is pronounced 'ah' as in father. E is pronounced 'eh' as in red. I is pronounced 'ee' as in machine. O is pronounced 'oh' as in for. U is pronounced 'oo' as in rule.

lessons.title: Ecclesiastical Pronunciation — Consonants
lessons.content: C before e, i, ae, oe is pronounced 'ch' as in church. Otherwise it is 'k'. G before e, i is 'j' as in joy. Otherwise 'g' as in go. GN is 'ny' as in canyon.
